name: bar_chart
description: A horizontal progress bar that fills based on a metric's current value. Ideal for disk usage, memory, and CPU thread loads.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to display in the bar chart

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: Override the maximum value for the bar. If not set, the max is automatically determined from the metric

config.name: corner_radius
config.label: Corner Radius
config.description: Rounds the corners of the bar. Set to 0 for sharp edges

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the bar

config.name: back_color
config.label: Back Color
config.description: The background color behind the bar

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the bar switches to the warning color

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The bar color when the warning threshold is exceeded

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of max value at which the bar switches to the critical color

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The bar color when the critical threshold is exceeded
